title: PhotoScout plugin registry (registry.json)
description: The catalogue a PhotoScout server reads. Mirrors parseRegistry in server/src/plugins/remote.ts of the photoscout repo. The rules a schema cannot state (latest is one of the versions, unique ids and versions, minCore is a semver range, zip URLs parse as https without credentials) are checked by scripts/registry-lib.mjs.

version.description: The registry format version. Must be the number 1.

pluginId.description: a reverse-DNS plugin id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at least two dot-separated parts, up to 100 characters (for example media.example.waze)

semver.description: a plain semver version: 1.2.3 or 1.2.3-beta.1 (no leading v, no +build)

description.description: one sentence on what the plugin does

author.description: the author's name, up to 200 characters

homepage.description: a URL for the plugin's page

category.description: one of map, feed, events, ai, tools. Must match the category in the plugin's plugin.json.

zip.description: an https URL of the plugin's .zip, without credentials

sha256.description: the sha256 of the .zip: 64 hex characters

minCore.description: a semver range of the PhotoScout core version the plugin needs

size.description: the size of the .zip in bytes
